basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and horror enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I'm a 24-year-old graphic designer working freelance, which gives me a lot of flexibility in terms of online hours. I'm usually online during late evenings, often lurking in gaming subreddits or discussing movie theories. I'm single and enjoy diving into the lore of games like Dead by Daylight and the Maze Runner series. I dislike toxicity in gaming communities and strive to foster a positive environment wherever I engage.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been gaming since my early teens, with a particular interest in horror and strategy games. Most of my knowledge comes from years of playing, watching gaming streams, and engaging with online gaming communities. My background in graphic design also helps me appreciate the artistic elements of game design.
